name: Julie Fahey
occupation: Speaker of the Oregon House; State Representative

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Fahey lists her occupation as Speaker of the Oregon House and state representative.
bio.excerpt: Speaker of the Oregon House; State Representative

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: Her statement lists a B.S. in Chemistry from the University of Notre Dame.
bio.excerpt: B.S. Chemistry, University of Notre Dame

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: Her statement lists prior governmental experience as Oregon House Majority Leader and state representative.
bio.excerpt: Oregon House Majority Leader; State Representative

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: Her official legislative page says it is an honor to serve as Speaker of the Oregon House.
bio.excerpt: It is a tremendous honor to serve you as Speaker of the Oregon House.

positions.statement: Fahey says she has worked to rein in the cost of housing by building more affordable homes and limiting rent increases.
positions.excerpt: Julie has worked tirelessly to rein in the cost of housing by building more affordable homes and limiting rent increases.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she championed an increase to the Earned Income Tax Credit this year.
positions.excerpt: she championed an increase to the Earned Income Tax Credit

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she has fought to ensure schools and teachers have the resources, support and staffing they need.
positions.excerpt: she's fought to ensure schools and teachers have the resources, support, and staffing they need to be successful.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: She says she supports a coordinated response to homelessness through supportive housing, social services, mental health care and substance abuse programs.
positions.excerpt: Julie supports a comprehensive, coordinated response to home- lessness through improved access to supportive housing, social services, mental health care, and substance abuse programs.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: At the Oregon Leadership Summit (Portland Tribune, Dec 2025), Fahey said she was open to discussing loosening land use rules, asking how to add flexibility while keeping what works.
positions.excerpt: How can we introduce some additional flexibility to the system while still keeping what works?

positions.statement: In a June 2026 email quoted by the Portland Tribune, Fahey said companies with a high volume of deliveries should pay their fair share for road use.
positions.excerpt: it's only reasonable to expect companies with a high volume of deliveries to pay their fair share
